ex.en: The paper is currently under peer review.
ex.zh: 這篇論文正在接受同儕審查。

ex.en: Peer review helps to keep research quality high.
ex.zh: 同儕審查有助於維持研究品質。

peer review.en: a check of someone's work by other experts in the same field

ex.en: Printers and scanners are common peripherals.
ex.zh: 印表機和掃描器是常見的周邊設備。

ex.en: This laptop has ports for many peripherals.
ex.zh: 這台筆電有很多可以接周邊設備的連接埠。

peripheral.en: a device connected to a computer, such as a printer

ex.en: Peripheral vision helps you see things at the side.
ex.zh: 周邊視覺讓你看到旁邊的東西。

ex.en: That issue is only peripheral to our discussion.
ex.zh: 那個問題和我們的討論只是枝節。

peripheral.en: on the edge of something, or less important

ex.en: She keeps a parrot as a pet.
ex.zh: 她養一隻鸚鵡作為寵物。

ex.en: Do you have any pets?
ex.zh: 你有養寵物嗎？

ex.en: She kept various kinds of pets.
ex.zh: 她養了各式各樣的寵物。

pet.en: an animal kept at home for company

ex.en: He was petting the dog.
ex.zh: 他在撫摸那隻狗。

ex.en: Can I pet your dog?
ex.zh: 我可以摸摸你的狗嗎？

pet.en: to touch an animal gently with your hand

ex.en: We gave the performer a round of applause.
ex.zh: 我們為表演者鼓掌。

ex.en: Tom is a street performer.
ex.zh: 湯姆是街頭藝人。

ex.en: With both song and dance, the performers put on an excellent show.
ex.zh: 表演者又唱又跳，帶來一場精彩的演出。

performer.en: a person who entertains people by acting, singing or dancing

performer.zh: （工作、投資等）表現…的人或事物

ex.en: Amy is one of our top performers.
ex.zh: Amy 是我們表現最好的員工之一。

ex.en: The stock was the best performer this year.
ex.zh: 這支股票是今年表現最好的。

performer.en: a person or thing that does well or badly at a task

ex.en: Please check your email periodically.
ex.zh: 請定期查看你的電子郵件。

ex.en: The software updates itself periodically.
ex.zh: 這個軟體會定期自動更新。

ex.en: We periodically review our prices.
ex.zh: 我們會定期檢討價格。

periodically.en: from time to time at regular times

ex.en: The library has many scientific periodicals.
ex.zh: 圖書館有很多科學期刊。

ex.en: She writes for several periodicals.
ex.zh: 她替好幾份期刊撰稿。

periodical.en: a magazine published at regular times

ex.en: The machines need periodical checks.
ex.zh: 這些機器需要定期檢查。

ex.en: We send periodical updates to our clients.
ex.zh: 我們會定期寄送最新消息給客戶。

periodical.en: happening again and again at regular times

ex.en: Over a thousand people signed the petition.
ex.zh: 超過一千人在請願書上連署。

ex.en: Residents started a petition against the new road.
ex.zh: 居民發起連署反對興建新道路。

petition.en: a written request signed by many people to ask for a change

ex.en: Parents petitioned the school to change the rule.
ex.zh: 家長向學校請願要求修改規定。

ex.en: They petitioned the city for a new park.
ex.zh: 他們向市政府請願興建新公園。

petition.en: to make a formal request to an authority

personalize.zh: 使個人化、客製化（如印上姓名）

ex.en: You can personalize your phone's home screen.
ex.zh: 你可以把手機主畫面設定成自己的風格。

ex.en: The website personalizes ads based on your interests.
ex.zh: 這個網站會根據你的興趣提供個人化廣告。

ex.en: We can personalize the mug with your name.
ex.zh: 我們可以在馬克杯上印上你的名字。

personalize.en: to make something suit one person, for example by adding their name

ex.en: Players will be penalized for being late.
ex.zh: 遲到的球員會受罰。

ex.en: The company was penalized for breaking safety rules.
ex.zh: 這家公司因違反安全規定而被處罰。

penalize.en: to punish someone for breaking a rule

ex.en: The new tax rules penalize small businesses.
ex.zh: 新的稅制對小型企業不利。

ex.en: The system penalizes people who work part-time.
ex.zh: 這個制度對兼職工作者不利。

penalize.en: to put someone in a worse position than others

ex.en: I seasoned the fish with salt and pepper.
ex.zh: 我用鹽和胡椒幫魚調味。

ex.en: Pass me the salt and pepper, please.
ex.zh: 請把鹽和胡椒遞給我。

pepper.en: a hot powder used to add flavor to food

ex.en: She hates green peppers.
ex.zh: 她討厭青椒。

ex.en: I don't want red bell peppers, I want green ones.
ex.zh: 我不要紅甜椒，我要綠的。

pepper.en: a hollow green, red or yellow vegetable that can be mild or hot

ex.en: The store has permanently closed.
ex.zh: 這家店已經永久歇業了。

ex.en: He moved to Canada permanently.
ex.zh: 他永久移居加拿大了。

permanently.en: in a way that lasts forever or for a very long time

ex.en: He learnt the periodic table by heart just for fun.
ex.zh: 他把元素週期表背下來只是為了好玩。

ex.en: The machine needs periodic maintenance.
ex.zh: 這台機器需要定期保養。

ex.en: We do periodic checks on all equipment.
ex.zh: 我們會定期檢查所有設備。

periodic.en: happening again and again at regular times

ex.en: When did the petrol gauge stop working?
ex.zh: 油表是什麼時候開始壞掉的？

ex.en: We need to stop for petrol soon.
ex.zh: 我們得趕快停下來加油。

ex.en: Petrol prices have gone up again.
ex.zh: 汽油價格又漲了。

petrol.en: fuel for cars, used in British English

ex.en: She persists in saying that her analysis is correct.
ex.zh: 她堅稱自己的分析是正確的。

ex.en: He persisted in his work until he succeeded.
ex.zh: 他堅持工作，直到成功為止。

persist.en: to keep doing something even when others disagree

ex.en: If the pain persists, see a doctor.
ex.zh: 如果持續疼痛，請就醫。

ex.en: Problems with the system persisted for weeks.
ex.zh: 系統問題持續了好幾週。

ex.en: Country life is very peaceful in comparison with city life.
ex.zh: 和都市生活相比，鄉村生活平靜多了。

ex.en: Jennifer lives a peaceful life in the small village, unlike us with our busy city lives.
ex.zh: 珍妮佛在小村莊裡過著平靜的生活，不像我們在城市裡那麼忙碌。

ex.en: The world which I saw in my dream was a peaceful world devoid of war.
ex.zh: 我在夢裡看到的是一個沒有戰爭、和平的世界。

ex.en: Both sides hope for a peaceful solution.
ex.zh: 雙方都希望能和平解決。

ex.en: Let's not argue over petty details.
ex.zh: 我們別為了瑣碎的細節爭吵。

ex.en: Don't waste your time on petty problems.
ex.zh: 別把時間浪費在小問題上。

ex.en: It was petty of him to complain about such a small amount.
ex.zh: 他為了這麼一點錢抱怨，真是小氣。

ex.en: She made a petty comment about my clothes.
ex.zh: 她對我的衣服說了些小心眼的話。

petty.en: caring too much about small, unimportant things

ex.en: You can take the money from petty cash.
ex.zh: 你可以從零用金裡拿這筆錢。

ex.en: Who is in charge of the petty cash?
ex.zh: 誰負責管理零用金？

petty.en: a small amount of money kept in an office for small costs

ex.en: A product that costs 10 reals in Brazil costs about 25 pesos in Argentina.
ex.zh: 在巴西賣 10 雷亞爾的商品，在阿根廷大約要 25 披索。

ex.en: The Mexican peso rose against the dollar.
ex.zh: 墨西哥披索對美元升值。

peso.en: the unit of money in several countries, such as Mexico

ex.en: I hung my hat on the peg.
ex.zh: 我把帽子掛在掛鉤上。

ex.en: Hang your coat on the peg by the door.
ex.zh: 把外套掛在門邊的掛鉤上。

peg.en: a small hook or pin on which things are hung

ex.en: The currency is pegged to the US dollar.
ex.zh: 這種貨幣與美元掛鉤。

ex.en: Prices were pegged at last year's level.
ex.zh: 價格被固定在去年的水準。

peg.en: to keep a price or rate at a fixed level

ex.en: The idea of perpetual motion is an absurd hypothesis.
ex.zh: 永動機的概念是個荒謬的假說。

ex.en: The city has a perpetual traffic problem.
ex.zh: 這座城市的交通問題永遠解決不了。

ex.en: Our industry is in a perpetual state of change.
ex.zh: 我們的產業一直處在不斷變化之中。

pensioner.zh: 領退休金的人、退休人士

ex.en: Many pensioners live on a fixed income.
ex.zh: 許多退休人士靠固定收入過活。

ex.en: The bus is free for pensioners.
ex.zh: 退休人士搭公車免費。

pensioner.en: a person who gets regular money from the government after leaving work

ex.en: The contract is still pending approval.
ex.zh: 這份合約還在等待核准。

ex.en: We have three pending orders.
ex.zh: 我們有三筆待處理的訂單。

pending.en: waiting to be decided or dealt with

ex.en: The decision has been postponed pending further review.
ex.zh: 決定延後，等待進一步審查。

ex.en: He was suspended pending an investigation.
ex.zh: 在調查結果出來前，他被停職了。

pending.en: while waiting for something, or until something happens

ex.en: Be patient and persistent. These things take time.
ex.zh: 要有耐心、堅持下去，這些事需要時間。

ex.en: His success is due more to his persistent hard work than to his talent.
ex.zh: 他的成功與其說來自天分，不如說來自持之以恆的努力。

persistent.en: not giving up even when things are difficult

ex.en: I have a persistent cough that won't go away.
ex.zh: 我一直咳嗽，怎麼都好不了。

ex.en: Persistent rain caused delays across the city.
ex.zh: 持續降雨造成全市交通延誤。

persistent.en: lasting for a long time and hard to get rid of

ex.en: The UN sent a peacekeeping force to the region.
ex.zh: 聯合國派遣維和部隊到該地區。

ex.en: She served on a peacekeeping mission in Africa.
ex.zh: 她曾在非洲參與維和任務。

peacekeeping.en: helping to stop fighting and keep calm between groups

ex.en: Most people only want to hear their own truth.
ex.zh: 大部分的人只想聽自己認定的真相。

ex.en: How many people will attend the meeting?
ex.zh: 有多少人會出席這場會議？

ex.en: There are a lot of different peoples in the world.
ex.zh: 世界上有許多不同的民族。

ex.en: There are several peoples in the country.
ex.zh: 這個國家有好幾個民族。

people.en: all the men, women and children of one nation or race

ex.en: I have never come across such a stubborn person.
ex.zh: 我從沒遇過這麼固執的人。

ex.en: This elevator is capable of carrying 10 persons at a time.
ex.zh: 這部電梯一次能載 10 個人。

ex.en: You need to sign the form in person.
ex.zh: 你必須親自簽署這份表格。

ex.en: It's nice to finally meet you in person.
ex.zh: 很高興終於見到你本人。

ex.en: Ten years is a really long period of time.
ex.zh: 十年真的是一段很長的時間。

ex.en: I looked after him for a period of time.
ex.zh: 我照顧了他一段時間。

ex.en: The students' lunch period is from twelve to one.
ex.zh: 學生的午餐時間是十二點到一點。

ex.en: In the Edo period, moon-viewing parties were very popular.
ex.zh: 在江戶時代，賞月宴會非常流行。

ex.en: We live in a wonderful period.
ex.zh: 我們生活在一個很棒的時代。

period.en: a part of history with its own special features

ex.en: What do you have the first period?
ex.zh: 你第一節是什麼課？

ex.en: We have English in the third period.
ex.zh: 我們第三節是英文課。

period.en: one of the parts of a school day

ex.en: Perhaps you are right, I have been selfish.
ex.zh: 也許你說得對，我一直都很自私。

ex.en: Perhaps it will rain in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 下午也許會下雨。

ex.en: It's the police, perhaps we should get out of their way.
ex.zh: 是警察，也許我們該讓路。

perhaps.en: used to say that something may be true

ex.en: More than 40 percent of the students go to university.
ex.zh: 超過四成的學生會上大學。

ex.en: They obtained a yield of 8 percent on their investment.
ex.zh: 他們的投資獲得了百分之八的報酬。

ex.en: Tom sells T-shirts at a 30 percent discount.
ex.zh: 湯姆的T恤打七折賣。

ex.en: We may combine your personal information with other information.
ex.zh: 我們可能會把您的個人資料和其他資訊結合。

ex.en: Tom doesn't care about protecting his personal information online.
ex.zh: 湯姆上網時不在乎保護自己的個人資料。

ex.en: Please forgive my asking such a personal question.
ex.zh: 請原諒我問這麼私人的問題。

personal.en: belonging to or concerning one particular person

ex.en: The manager made a personal visit to the client.
ex.zh: 經理親自拜訪客戶。

ex.en: She gave the matter her personal attention.
ex.zh: 她親自處理這件事。

personal.en: done by you yourself, not by someone else

ex.en: Mark performed in front of people.
ex.zh: 馬克在眾人面前表演。

ex.en: The students performed Hamlet.
ex.zh: 學生們演出了《哈姆雷特》。

ex.en: The band will perform live tonight.
ex.zh: 這個樂團今晚會現場演出。

perform.en: to entertain people by acting, singing or playing music

ex.en: The doctor performed the surgery successfully.
ex.zh: 醫生順利完成了手術。

ex.en: The system performs a backup every night.
ex.zh: 系統每晚都會執行備份。

perform.en: to do a task or piece of work

ex.en: Most teams perform better when they have a home game.
ex.zh: 大多數球隊在主場比賽時表現得比較好。

ex.en: Our sales team performed well this quarter.
ex.zh: 我們的業務團隊這一季表現很好。

perform.en: to work or act well or badly

ex.en: Each movement of the dancer was perfect.
ex.zh: 這位舞者的每個動作都很完美。

ex.en: This English composition is far from perfect.
ex.zh: 這篇英文作文還差得遠呢。

ex.en: Nothing in the world is flawless and perfect.
ex.zh: 世界上沒有十全十美的東西。

perfect.en: as good as it could possibly be

ex.en: She spent a year in London to perfect her English.
ex.zh: 她在倫敦待了一年，讓英文更精進。

ex.en: The chef perfected the recipe over many years.
ex.zh: 主廚花了多年把這道食譜改良到完美。

perfect.en: to make something as good as it can be

ex.en: What percentage of all taxi drivers make unscrupulous detours, do you think?
ex.zh: 你覺得故意繞遠路的計程車司機佔了多少百分比？

ex.en: A large percentage of our customers are students.
ex.zh: 我們有很大比例的顧客是學生。

ex.en: What percentage of the budget is spent on marketing?
ex.zh: 預算有多少百分比花在行銷上？

percentage.en: an amount shown as a part of one hundred

ex.en: We are all longing for peace in the world.
ex.zh: 我們都渴望世界和平。

ex.en: He worked hard for peace for these ten years.
ex.zh: 這十年來，他一直為和平努力。

ex.en: Our ultimate goal is to establish world peace.
ex.zh: 我們的最終目標是建立世界和平。

peace.en: a time without war or fighting

ex.en: I just want some peace and quiet.
ex.zh: 我只想要一點清靜。

ex.en: Can you leave me in peace for an hour?
ex.zh: 你能讓我安靜一個小時嗎？

peace.en: a quiet and calm feeling or situation

ex.en: Try to see things from the customer's perspective.
ex.zh: 試著從顧客的角度看事情。

ex.en: Living abroad gave me a new perspective on life.
ex.zh: 住在國外讓我對人生有了新的看法。

ex.en: From a business perspective, the plan makes sense.
ex.zh: 從商業角度來看，這個計畫是合理的。

perspective.en: a particular way of thinking about something

perspective.zh: 正確看待事情的態度（keep / put in perspective）

ex.en: Try to keep things in perspective.
ex.zh: 試著用正確的角度看待事情。

ex.en: Losing one client isn't the end of the world; let's put it in perspective.
ex.zh: 失去一個客戶不是世界末日，我們要理性看待。

perspective.en: a sensible way of judging how important something is

ex.en: I get a kick out of her cheerful personality.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡她開朗的個性。

ex.en: She has a very open personality.
ex.zh: 她的個性很坦率。

ex.en: There are a lot of things you don't know about my personality.
ex.zh: 你對我的個性還有很多不了解的地方。

personality.en: the qualities that make up how a person behaves and feels

ex.en: Noted literary personalities gathered together last evening.
ex.zh: 知名文學界人士昨晚齊聚一堂。

ex.en: He is a well-known TV personality.
ex.zh: 他是知名的電視名人。

personality.en: a well-known person, especially in entertainment

ex.en: The peak of Fujiyama was covered with snow.
ex.zh: 富士山頂覆蓋著白雪。

ex.en: We reached the peak after a four-hour climb.
ex.zh: 我們爬了四個小時才登上山頂。

peak.en: the pointed top of a mountain

ex.en: The excitement reached its peak.
ex.zh: 興奮的情緒到達了頂點。

ex.en: Sales reach their peak in December.
ex.zh: 銷售量在十二月達到高峰。

peak.en: the highest or best point of something

ex.en: Tickets are more expensive during peak season.
ex.zh: 旺季時票價比較貴。

ex.en: Avoid driving during peak hours.
ex.zh: 盡量避開尖峰時段開車。

peak.en: at the highest or busiest level

ex.en: Prices peaked in 2021.
ex.zh: 價格在 2021 年達到高峰。

ex.en: Traffic usually peaks around 6 p.m.
ex.zh: 車流量通常在傍晚六點左右達到高峰。

peak.en: to reach the highest point or level

ex.en: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.
ex.zh: 正職工作比臨時工作好。

ex.en: Please give me your permanent address.
ex.zh: 請給我你的永久地址。

ex.en: Absolutely nothing is permanent in life.
ex.zh: 人生中沒有什麼是永久的。

permanent.en: lasting for a long time or for ever

ex.en: All that you say is perfectly correct.
ex.zh: 你說的完全正確。

ex.en: I understand your position perfectly.
ex.zh: 我完全理解你的立場。

ex.en: Your conduct is perfectly legal.
ex.zh: 你的行為完全合法。

ex.en: That word describes it perfectly.
ex.zh: 這個字形容得恰到好處。

ex.en: The dress fits you perfectly.
ex.zh: 這件洋裝你穿起來非常合身。

perfectly.en: in a way that could not be better

ex.en: I will personally visit you.
ex.zh: 我會親自去拜訪你。

ex.en: I know Tom personally.
ex.zh: 我私下認識湯姆。

ex.en: The CEO personally thanked every employee.
ex.zh: 執行長親自向每位員工道謝。

personally.en: done by you yourself, not by someone else

ex.en: Personally, I prefer working from home.
ex.zh: 就我個人而言，我比較喜歡在家工作。

ex.en: Personally, I think it's a great idea.
ex.zh: 我個人認為這是個好主意。

personally.en: used to show that you are giving your own opinion

personally.zh: take it personally：當作是針對自己、往心裡去

ex.en: Don't take it personally.
ex.zh: 別往心裡去。

ex.en: He takes every criticism personally.
ex.zh: 他把每一句批評都當成是針對他。

personally.en: to feel upset because you think a remark is aimed at you

ex.en: Children imitate their peers rather than their parents.
ex.zh: 孩子比較會模仿同儕，而不是父母。

ex.en: Teenagers often feel pressure from their peers.
ex.zh: 青少年常感受到來自同儕的壓力。

peer.en: a person who is the same age or has the same position or abilities as you

ex.en: My cat peers bemusedly at her reflection in the water.
ex.zh: 我的貓困惑地盯著自己在水中的倒影。

ex.en: She peered through the window to see who was there.
ex.zh: 她從窗戶往外仔細看是誰在那裡。

peer.en: to look closely or with effort at something, often because it is hard to see

ex.en: People over 65 can receive a pension from the government.
ex.zh: 65 歲以上的人可以向政府領取退休金。

ex.en: My father lives on his pension.
ex.zh: 我父親靠退休金過活。

ex.en: The company offers a good pension plan.
ex.zh: 這家公司提供不錯的退休金方案。

pension.en: money paid regularly to a person who has stopped working because of age or illness

ex.en: She tried to persuade him to attend the meeting.
ex.zh: 她試著說服他參加會議。

ex.en: I persuaded him to give up the idea.
ex.zh: 我說服他放棄了這個想法。

ex.en: I finally persuaded him to buy it.
ex.zh: 我終於說服他買下來了。

persuade.en: to make someone agree to do or believe something by giving reasons

ex.en: I perceive by your face that you have good news.
ex.zh: 從你的表情看得出你有好消息。

ex.en: I perceived a change in her attitude.
ex.zh: 我察覺到她的態度變了。

perceive.en: to notice or become aware of something through your senses or by thinking

perceive.zh: 認為、視為（perceive A as B）

ex.en: The brand is perceived as high quality.
ex.zh: 這個品牌被視為高品質的代表。

ex.en: Many people perceive him as arrogant.
ex.zh: 很多人認為他很傲慢。

perceive.en: to think of someone or something in a particular way

ex.en: Perception is reality.
ex.zh: 認知即現實。

ex.en: Public perception of the brand has improved.
ex.zh: 大眾對這個品牌的印象改善了。

ex.en: The ad changed my perception of the company.
ex.zh: 這支廣告改變了我對這家公司的看法。

perception.en: the way you think about or understand someone or something

ex.en: Lack of sleep can affect your perception.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足會影響你的感知能力。

ex.en: Color perception varies from person to person.
ex.zh: 每個人對顏色的感知不同。

perception.en: the ability to see, hear, or notice things through the senses

ex.en: If you need a pen, I'll lend you one.
ex.zh: 如果你需要筆，我借你一支。

ex.en: This is the same pen that I lost yesterday.
ex.zh: 這支筆跟我昨天弄丟的那支一樣。

ex.en: Do you have a lot of pens?
ex.zh: 你有很多支筆嗎？

pen.en: a tool with ink that you use for writing

ex.en: The teacher granted me permission to go home early.
ex.zh: 老師准許我提早回家。

ex.en: You shouldn't read other people's private letters without permission.
ex.zh: 你不應該未經允許就看別人的私人信件。

ex.en: I have to ask my dad for permission.
ex.zh: 我得先問我爸同不同意。

permission.en: the act of allowing someone to do something

ex.en: You don't have permission to open this folder.
ex.zh: 你沒有開啟這個資料夾的權限。

ex.en: Ask IT to give you permission to edit the file.
ex.zh: 請資訊部門給你編輯這個檔案的權限。

permission.en: the right given to a user to open or change files on a computer

ex.en: There is a penalty for late payment.
ex.zh: 逾期付款會被罰款。

ex.en: You'll pay a penalty if you cancel the contract early.
ex.zh: 提前解約要支付違約金。

penalty.en: a punishment or fee for breaking a rule or law

ex.en: We should abolish the death penalty.
ex.zh: 我們應該廢除死刑。

ex.en: The death penalty had been done away with in many states in the USA.
ex.zh: 美國很多州已經廢除了死刑。

penalty.en: a punishment given by a court or the law for a serious crime

ex.en: The fans went silent as they nervously watched the penalty shootout between the two teams.
ex.zh: 兩隊進行 PK 大戰時，球迷們都緊張得安靜下來。

ex.en: The referee gave the team a penalty in the last minute.
ex.zh: 裁判在最後一分鐘判給那支球隊罰球。

penalty.en: a free shot at the goal given to a team when the other team breaks a rule

ex.en: As usual the peasants are busy scattering grain seeds.
ex.zh: 農民們和往常一樣忙著播種。

ex.en: Most peasants in the village grew rice.
ex.zh: 村裡大部分農民都種稻。

peasant.en: a poor person who works on the land, especially in the past or in poor countries

ex.en: Farmers are fighting pests that destroy their crops.
ex.zh: 農民正在對抗破壞農作物的害蟲。

ex.en: Cockroaches are common household pests.
ex.zh: 蟑螂是常見的居家害蟲。

pest.en: a small animal or insect that harms crops or food

ex.en: My little brother can be a real pest.
ex.zh: 我弟弟有時候真的很煩人。

ex.en: Stop being such a pest and let me work.
ex.zh: 別再煩我了，讓我工作。

pest.en: a person who annoys you, especially by bothering you again and again

ex.en: Wash fruit well to remove pesticides.
ex.zh: 水果要洗乾淨才能去除農藥。

ex.en: These vegetables are grown without pesticides.
ex.zh: 這些蔬菜是不用農藥種的。

pesticide.en: a chemical used to kill insects that harm plants and crops

perverse.zh: 故意作對的、違反常理的

ex.en: It seems perverse to raise prices when sales are falling.
ex.zh: 在銷量下滑時漲價，似乎有違常理。

ex.en: He takes a perverse pleasure in arguing with everyone.
ex.zh: 他以跟每個人唱反調為樂，真是彆扭。

perverse.en: acting against what is sensible or expected, often on purpose

ex.en: This baby penguin is too cute!
ex.zh: 這隻企鵝寶寶太可愛了！

ex.en: I like penguins.
ex.zh: 我喜歡企鵝。

ex.en: Penguins can't fly, but they swim very well.
ex.zh: 企鵝不會飛，但很會游泳。

penguin.en: a black and white sea bird that cannot fly and lives in cold places

ex.en: Don't be so pessimistic.
ex.zh: 不要感覺那麼悲觀。

ex.en: You're being too pessimistic.
ex.zh: 你太悲觀了。

ex.en: Everyone feels pessimistic.
ex.zh: 每個人都感到悲觀。

pessimistic.en: expecting bad things to happen and not hopeful about the future

ex.en: This milk has a peculiar smell.
ex.zh: 這牛奶有特殊的氣味。

ex.en: "So what do you think of Mary?" "She has a rather peculiar appearance."
ex.zh: ”那你怎麼看瑪麗？“ ”她看起來挺古怪的。“

ex.en: He has a peculiar way of walking.
ex.zh: 他走路的樣子很奇特。

peculiar.en: strange or unusual in a way that may be unpleasant

ex.en: He said with a perplexed expression, "I've heard nothing, so I can't say anything."
ex.zh: 他的目光十分困惑：「我甚麼也沒聽過，所以甚麼也說不出來。」

ex.en: The difficult riddle perplexed all the students.
ex.zh: 這個困難的謎語讓所有學生都百思不解。

ex.en: His strange behavior perplexed his friends.
ex.zh: 他古怪的行為讓朋友們摸不著頭腦。

perplex.en: to make someone feel confused because something is hard to understand

ex.en: Mayuko always aims for perfection.
ex.zh: 麻由子總是追求完美。

ex.en: Perfection isn't good enough.
ex.zh: 完美還不夠好。

ex.en: The steak was cooked to perfection.
ex.zh: 那塊牛排煎得恰到好處。

perfection.en: the state of being as good as it is possible to be, with no faults

ex.en: Optimism is like the lamp of hope. Pessimism [or negativity] is like a drug of sorrow.
ex.zh: 樂觀如明燈,照亮希望的前程. 消極如毒品,腐蝕健康的心靈.

ex.en: There is a growing sense of pessimism about the economy.
ex.zh: 人們對經濟的悲觀情緒日益升高。

ex.en: Her pessimism made it hard for her to enjoy the trip.
ex.zh: 她的悲觀讓她很難享受這趟旅行。

pessimism.en: the habit of expecting bad things to happen

ex.en: Tell the doctor if you are allergic to penicillin.
ex.zh: 如果你對盤尼西林過敏，要告訴醫生。

ex.en: Penicillin was the first widely used antibiotic.
ex.zh: 青黴素是第一種被廣泛使用的抗生素。

penicillin.en: a medicine that kills bacteria and is used to treat infections

ex.en: Perseverance, as you know, is the key to success.
ex.zh: 就像你們知道的那樣，毅力是成功的關鍵。

ex.en: I was surprised by his perseverance.
ex.zh: 我對他的堅持感到很驚訝。

ex.en: There's no success without perseverance.
ex.zh: 沒有堅持，就沒有成功。

perseverance.en: the quality of continuing to try hard even when something is difficult

ex.en: Have you ever been to the Korean Peninsula?
ex.zh: 你去過朝鮮半島嗎？

ex.en: Italy is a peninsula.
ex.zh: 義大利是一個半島。

peninsula.en: a long piece of land that is almost surrounded by water

ex.en: Only authorized personnel may enter this area.
ex.zh: 僅限授權人員進入此區。

ex.en: The hospital is short of medical personnel.
ex.zh: 醫院缺乏醫護人員。

personnel.en: all the people who work for a company or organization

ex.en: Please send your resume to Personnel.
ex.zh: 請把履歷寄到人事部。

ex.en: He works in the personnel department.
ex.zh: 他在人事部工作。

personnel.en: the department of a company that deals with hiring and looking after workers

ex.en: He was able to put up remarkable performances at the sports competition.
ex.zh: 他在運動會上表現非常出色。

ex.en: I am not very satisfied with today's performance.
ex.zh: 我對我今天的表現不是很滿意。

ex.en: I'm not very pleased with my performance today.
ex.zh: 我對我今天的表現並不是很滿意。

performance.en: how well a person or thing does a job or task

ex.en: When I am in London, I will most probably go catch a few performances.
ex.zh: 我在倫敦的時候，應該會去看一兩場演出。

ex.en: Lately there have been constant dance rehearsals; Performances will be on Friday and Saturday.
ex.zh: 最近一直在排練舞蹈，週五和週六要演出。

performance.en: an occasion when someone entertains an audience with music, acting, or dance

ex.en: Employees get a per diem of 60 dollars for meals.
ex.zh: 員工每天有 60 美元的餐費津貼。

ex.en: The per diem covers food and local transportation.
ex.zh: 每日津貼涵蓋餐費和當地交通。

per diem.en: money paid to an employee for each day of work travel to cover costs

ex.en: He presented a persuasive case for the budget increase.
ex.zh: 他提出了有說服力的理由，支持增加預算。

ex.en: The proposal includes persuasive market data.
ex.zh: 這份提案附有具說服力的市場數據。

persuasive.en: able to make people agree or do something by giving good reasons

ex.en: A flexible schedule is a popular job perk.
ex.zh: 彈性工時是很受歡迎的工作福利。

ex.en: One perk of the role is paid professional training.
ex.zh: 這個職位的一項額外福利是提供帶薪專業訓練。

perk.en: an extra benefit that you get from your job besides money

ex.en: Perishable goods must be stored at the right temperature.
ex.zh: 易腐商品必須以適當溫度保存。

ex.en: The shipment contains perishable food products.
ex.zh: 這批貨物包含易腐食品。

perishable.en: likely to go bad quickly, usually said of food

ex.en: We hire extra staff during the peak season.
ex.zh: 旺季期間我們會額外聘請人手。

ex.en: Shipping delays are common in the peak season.
ex.zh: 旺季時常會出現運送延誤。

peak season.en: the time of year when a business is busiest or has the most customers

ex.en: Tom is a pediatrician.
ex.zh: 湯姆是兒科醫師。

ex.en: Ask your pediatrician which vaccinations are due this year.
ex.zh: 請詢問兒科醫師今年需要接種哪些疫苗。

pediatrician.en: a doctor who treats babies and children

ex.en: The penthouse offers a clear view of the harbor.
ex.zh: 這間頂樓公寓可以清楚眺望港口。

ex.en: The hotel reserved its penthouse suite for the visiting director.
ex.zh: 飯店將頂層套房保留給來訪的主管。

penthouse.en: an expensive apartment or room on the top floor of a tall building

ex.en: When the light is green, cars turning must yield to pedestrians.
ex.zh: 綠燈時，轉彎車輛必須禮讓行人。

ex.en: It was the morning rush hour, and there were a lot of passing pedestrians and cars.
ex.zh: 當時正是早上尖峰時間，路上行人和車輛很多。

pedestrian.en: a person who is walking, especially along a road or street

ex.en: The interface of this website is somewhat pedestrian, but it’s simple.
ex.zh: 這個網站的介面沒有甚麼新意，但是卻很簡潔。

ex.en: His writing style is rather pedestrian.
ex.zh: 他的文筆相當平淡無奇。

pedestrian.en: ordinary and not interesting or exciting

ex.en: The two birds built a nest without a building permit.
ex.zh: 那兩隻鳥沒有建築許可就築了巢。

ex.en: You need a work permit to work in this country.
ex.zh: 在這個國家工作需要工作許可證。

permit.en: an official paper that says you are allowed to do something

ex.en: If time permits, I'll visit the museum.
ex.zh: 如果時間允許，我會去參觀博物館。

ex.en: Weather permitting, we will leave in an hour.
ex.zh: 天氣允許的話，我們一小時後出發。

ex.en: Do you think Tom will permit Mary to do that?
ex.zh: 你認為湯姆會允許瑪麗這麼做嗎？

permit.en: to allow something to happen or allow someone to do something

ex.en: These rules pertain to all employees.
ex.zh: 這些規定適用於所有員工。

ex.en: Please send me any documents that pertain to the case.
ex.zh: 請把所有和這個案子有關的文件寄給我。

pertain.en: to be connected with or related to something

ex.en: The car was going eighty kilometres per hour.
ex.zh: 那輛車以每小時八十公里的速度行駛。

ex.en: Tickets cost two hundred dollars per person.
ex.zh: 門票每人兩百元。

ex.en: Orange peel can be used to flavor cakes.
ex.zh: 柳橙皮可以用來為蛋糕調味。

ex.en: He slipped on a banana peel.
ex.zh: 他踩到香蕉皮滑倒了。

ex.en: Please peel the potatoes before boiling them.
ex.zh: 煮馬鈴薯之前請先削皮。

ex.en: She peeled an apple with a small knife.
ex.zh: 她用小刀削了一顆蘋果。

ex.en: The paint on the wall is starting to peel.
ex.zh: 牆上的油漆開始剝落了。

ex.en: My nose peeled after too much sun.
ex.zh: 我曬太多太陽後鼻子脫皮了。

ex.en: I found a penny on the sidewalk this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我在人行道上撿到一枚一分錢硬幣。

ex.en: Every penny counts when you're saving for something big.
ex.zh: 為了大目標存錢時，每一分錢都很重要。

ex.en: Please write your answers in pencil so you can erase them.
ex.zh: 請用鉛筆寫答案，這樣才可以擦掉。

ex.en: I need to sharpen my pencil before the test.
ex.zh: 考試前我得先削鉛筆。

ex.en: She penciled a note on the edge of the page.
ex.zh: 她用鉛筆在頁面邊緣寫了一則備註。

ex.en: He penciled in the outline before using ink.
ex.zh: 他先用鉛筆畫出輪廓，再上墨水。

ex.en: I like peanut butter on my toast.
ex.zh: 我喜歡在吐司上抹花生醬。

ex.en: She is allergic to peanuts.
ex.zh: 她對花生過敏。

ex.en: We shared a bag of roasted peanuts.
ex.zh: 我們分著吃了一袋烤花生。

ex.en: Peter is a common name in many countries.
ex.zh: 彼得是許多國家都很常見的名字。

ex.en: Peter and his friends play soccer after school.
ex.zh: 彼得和他的朋友們放學後踢足球。

peter.zh: 逐漸減少、逐漸消失（peter out）

ex.en: The stream petered out in the dry season.
ex.zh: 這條小溪在乾季漸漸乾涸了。

ex.en: Her excitement slowly petered out as the day went on.
ex.zh: 隨著時間過去，她的興奮感漸漸消退了。

ex.en: She is learning Persian so she can read old poetry.
ex.zh: 她在學波斯語，好讀懂古老的詩歌。

ex.en: Persian is the main language spoken in Iran.
ex.zh: 波斯語是伊朗的主要語言。

ex.en: Many people perceived the change as a good sign.
ex.zh: 許多人把這個改變視為好兆頭。

ex.en: She perceived a slight sadness in his voice.
ex.zh: 她察覺到他的聲音裡有一絲哀傷。

pence.zh: 便士（英國貨幣單位，penny 的複數）

ex.en: The candy costs fifty pence at the corner shop.
ex.zh: 這種糖在街角商店要五十便士。

ex.en: I found a few pence on the floor of the bus.
ex.zh: 我在公車地板上撿到幾個便士。

ex.en: A pound is worth one hundred pence.
ex.zh: 一英鎊等於一百便士。

pete.zh: 皮特（男子名，Peter 的暱稱）

ex.en: Pete makes the best pancakes on Sunday mornings.
ex.zh: 皮特週日早上做的鬆餅最好吃。

ex.en: Pete forgot his umbrella again, so he got wet.
ex.zh: 皮特又忘了帶傘，所以淋濕了。

ex.en: The sharp nail penetrated the thick wooden board.
ex.zh: 尖銳的釘子穿透了厚木板。

ex.en: Sunlight cannot penetrate the dense forest canopy.
ex.zh: 陽光無法穿透茂密的林冠。

ex.en: The cold air penetrated my thin jacket.
ex.zh: 冷空氣滲進了我單薄的外套。

ex.en: The company is trying to penetrate the Asian market.
ex.zh: 這家公司正試圖打進亞洲市場。

ex.en: She added a handful of green peas to the fried rice.
ex.zh: 她在炒飯裡加了一把青豌豆。

ex.en: The little boy refused to eat his peas.
ex.zh: 那個小男孩不肯吃他的豌豆。

ex.en: Mendel studied pea plants to learn about heredity.
ex.zh: 孟德爾研究豌豆植物來了解遺傳。

ex.en: I bought a ripe peach at the market this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上在市場買了一顆熟透的桃子。

ex.en: Peach juice is sweet and goes well with ice.
ex.zh: 桃子汁很甜，加冰塊很好喝。

ex.en: She baked a peach pie for the picnic.
ex.zh: 她為野餐烤了一個桃子派。

ex.en: Peat forms slowly from dead plants in wet ground.
ex.zh: 泥炭是由潮濕土地中的死去植物慢慢形成的。

ex.en: In some places, people burn peat to heat their homes.
ex.zh: 在某些地方，人們燒泥炭來為家裡取暖。

ex.en: Gardeners often mix peat into the soil.
ex.zh: 園丁常把泥炭混進土壤裡。

ex.en: A small bird perched on the branch outside my window.
ex.zh: 一隻小鳥棲息在我窗外的樹枝上。

ex.en: She perched on the edge of the chair and waited.
ex.zh: 她坐在椅子邊緣等著。

ex.en: The village is perched on a cliff above the sea.
ex.zh: 這座村莊坐落在海邊的懸崖上。

ex.en: The parrot jumped back onto its perch.
ex.zh: 鸚鵡跳回牠的棲木上。

ex.en: From his perch on the roof, he could see the whole town.
ex.zh: 從屋頂上的高處，他能看到整個小鎮。

ex.en: She wore a necklace made of white pearls.
ex.zh: 她戴著一條白色珍珠做成的項鍊。

ex.en: Divers found a large pearl inside the oyster.
ex.zh: 潛水員在牡蠣裡找到一顆很大的珍珠。

ex.en: Measure the perimeter of the garden before buying the fence.
ex.zh: 買圍籬之前，先量一下花園的周長。

ex.en: The perimeter of a square with sides of 4 meters is 16 meters.
ex.zh: 邊長四公尺的正方形，周長是十六公尺。

ex.en: Guards walked around the perimeter of the building.
ex.zh: 警衛繞著大樓外圍巡邏。

ex.en: A tall fence marks the perimeter of the farm.
ex.zh: 一道高高的圍籬標出農場的邊界。

ex.en: She put on some perfume before the party.
ex.zh: 她在派對前噴了一點香水。

ex.en: The perfume of roses filled the room.
ex.zh: 玫瑰的香氣瀰漫整個房間。

ex.en: Flowers perfumed the air in the garden.
ex.zh: 花朵讓花園的空氣充滿香氣。

ex.en: She perfumed her letters with lavender.
ex.zh: 她在信上灑了薰衣草香水。

ex.en: Peru is a country in South America.
ex.zh: 秘魯是南美洲的一個國家。

ex.en: Machu Picchu is one of the most famous places in Peru.
ex.zh: 馬丘比丘是秘魯最著名的景點之一。

ex.en: Smartphones have become pervasive in modern life.
ex.zh: 智慧型手機在現代生活中已無所不在。

ex.en: A pervasive smell of smoke filled the house.
ex.zh: 一股瀰漫的煙味充滿了整間屋子。

ex.en: I packed an apple and a pear for my lunch.
ex.zh: 我帶了一顆蘋果和一顆梨子當午餐。

ex.en: This pear is so juicy that it dripped down my chin.
ex.zh: 這顆梨子汁多到流到我的下巴。

ex.en: The country has changed its penal system in recent years.
ex.zh: 這個國家近年修改了刑罰制度。

ex.en: He studied penal law at university.
ex.zh: 他在大學裡研讀刑法。

ex.en: She peeked through the door to see who was there.
ex.zh: 她從門縫偷看是誰在外面。

ex.en: Don't peek at your present before your birthday.
ex.zh: 生日前不要偷看你的禮物。

ex.en: Take a peek at this photo and tell me what you think.
ex.zh: 瞄一眼這張照片，告訴我你的想法。

ex.en: He took a quick peek at his phone during dinner.
ex.zh: 他在晚餐時快速瞄了一下手機。

ex.en: Her persistence finally paid off when she won the prize.
ex.zh: 她的堅持終於在得獎時有了回報。

ex.en: Learning a language takes time and persistence.

ex.zh: 她的道歉感覺像在做樣子，而不是真心的。

ex.en: Out of sheer perversity, he did the opposite of what we asked.
ex.zh: 他純粹出於故意作對，做了和我們要求相反的事。

ex.en: The perversity of the situation made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 這情況荒謬得違反常理，逗得大家都笑了。

ex.en: The festival ensures the perpetuation of local traditions.
ex.zh: 這個節慶確保了當地傳統得以延續。

ex.en: Some worry that the policy leads to the perpetuation of poverty.
ex.zh: 有些人擔心這項政策會讓貧窮延續下去。

ex.en: After careful perusal of the contract, she signed it.
ex.zh: 仔細閱讀合約後，她簽了名。

ex.en: The documents are available for your perusal at the front desk.
ex.zh: 文件放在櫃檯，供您細閱。

ex.en: In autumn, my grandmother dries persimmons in the sun.
ex.zh: 秋天時，我外婆會把柿子拿去曬乾。

ex.en: A ripe persimmon is soft and very sweet.
ex.zh: 熟透的柿子又軟又甜。

pensionable.zh: 可領退休金的；符合領退休金資格的

ex.en: He is nearing pensionable age and plans to retire soon.
ex.zh: 他接近可領退休金的年紀，打算很快退休。

ex.en: Only full-time staff receive pensionable salary.
ex.zh: 只有全職員工的薪資才計入退休金。

ex.en: Use a peeler to remove the skin from the potatoes.
ex.zh: 用削皮器把馬鈴薯的皮削掉。

ex.en: I bought a new peeler for the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我為廚房買了一支新的削皮器。
